mods.utub: Use earth bound structures to fight on your side.  Earth structures have large splash damage.
Train a follower Gaia, which builds Earth based structures.
Light earth tower, does 3-6, and some splash damage. |n|n|cffffcc00Attacks land and air units.|r
Basic tower of the crystal defense. The Crystal Shooter has relatively high chaos damage for its cost.
The second tower of crystal defense. Does much higher damage than the Shooter, and also deals splash damage.
The Crystal Fury is a fast attacking tower with high damage and critical strike. One of the deadliest towers of crystal defense.
The Crystal Slower is one of the best slowing towers in the game. It deals splash damage and slows the enemies. It costs quite a bit, however.
The ultimate tower of crystal defense. Extremely high damage at a fast speed. Huge range to top it all off. It all comes at a high price. It's worth it.
The Crystal Towers are generally higher in quality than the other tower types, but are also more expensive. Strategic placement of these towers is the key.
The Crystal Bouncer has a high range and moderate attack power. It is equipped with the Moon Glaive ability, so it's attacks bounce off the enemies. It's speed is matched only by the Crystal Fury.
Light fire tower, does light damage. 3-8 damage, and light splash damage. |n|n|cffffcc00Attacks land and air units.|r
Fire worker. Can build various fire structures
Allows you to summon the powers of fire to aid you. Fire towers have moderate damage and splash damage. Fire Towers do extra damage to Heavy Armor, but reduced to Fortified and Light.

Build a Tech Center to build towers equipped with human technology. Tech towers have long range and moderate damage, but long cooldowns. Tech Towers do extra damage to heavy armor, and reduced to fortified and light.
Tech worker, can build technology buildings
The Power Plant trains electricity to do your bidding. Electric Towers have a fast attack and cooldown, but low damage. Electricity does extra damage to light armored units.
Electric builder, can buld electricity based buildings
Light electric tower. Does light damage in moderate range. Attacks extremely fast. 4 damage. |n|n|cffffcc00Attacks land and air units.|r
Conjure up hunks of stone to assist you. Stone Towers have high damage and low range. Stone Towers sometimes do 2x damage, and do extra damage to fortified armor.
Stone Worker, builds stone buildings. This builder SUMMONS, meaning, do not stand there after he started building
Beginning Stone Tower. Moderate damage, 10-25 and does 2x damage. |n|n|cffffcc00Attacks land and air units.|r
The Storm Caller is a large advance in the Electric line. It's damage is much higher, but it's range slightly lower. 30 damage. |n|n|cffffcc00Attacks land and air units.|r
Medium fire tower. Has greater splash damage and attacks fairly quickly. 20-50 damage. |n|n|cffffcc00Attacks land and air units.|r

Poison brings moderate damage, medium range, and medium rate of fire. In addition, they slow units. But the cost of poison doesn't make these the cheapest towers around. Poison Towers do equal damage to all armor types.
Light poison tower. Good range, damage, and rate of fire. 4-8 damage. |n|n|cffffcc00Attacks land and air units.|r
Poison worker. This guy builds poison towers

Creates Ice to fight on your side. Ice Towers slow enemy units, as well as having a nice rate of fire, but somwhat low range. Ice Towers have a high minimum damage. Ice Towers do extra damage to light armor, and reduced to fortified
Basic Ice Structure. Decent rate of fire, good minimum damage, slows enemies. 6 damage |n|n|cffffcc00Attacks land and air units.|r
The builder of Ice Towers
The next in the line of Poison. These towers have a slightly longer cooldown, but much higher damage. Also slows units. 20-35 Damage |n|n|cffffcc00Attacks land and air units.|r
Next in the Stone line is the Rock Blaster. This structure has higher damage and range, but attacks a tiny bit slower. 55-100 Damage. |n|n|cffffcc00Attacks land and air units.|r

This may not do much physical damage, but it nails many enemies with it's chain lightning attack. Very short range and medium cooldown. 1 standard damage + Chain Lightning |n|n|cffffcc00Attacks land and air units.|r
Ice just improved again. The Blizzard Master is a expensive, but worthwhile investment. 80-90 damage. |n|n|cffffcc00Attacks land and air units.|r
The next step up in snow defense, the snowball launcher has far higher damage, and fires further. It attacks faster, too. 26 damage |n|n|cffffcc00Attacks land and air units.|r
One step for Stone, one giant leap for defense. The Stone Projector attacks a little slower, but it's damage is far higher. 190-250 damage. |n|n|cffffcc00Attacks land and air units.|r

Alas, Human Tech will never stop. The V2 Rocket launcher has a higher range and far greater damage, but reloading takes time, so the cooldown's a big greater. 100-130 damage |n|n|cffffcc00Attacks land units and trees.|r

A great addition to any Tech defense, the Ion Cannon Center does a LOT of damage at enormous range. The cooldown, is, of course, greater as well. 300-375 damage +500 damage on impact |n|n|cffffcc00Attacks land and air units.|r

A breakthrough in Poison results in the Sludge Flinger. With the highest range of all the Poison towers, it can deal it's high damage at a great range, but with slower results. 70-90 damage |n|n|cffffcc00Attacks land units.|r

The final defense for Ice will more than do a good job. While it has no special abilities, it does a large payload of damage. 700-700 damage. |n|n|cffffcc00Attacks land and air units.|r

This tower puts the Z in Laser. (Wait...) This tower has the strengths of all the elements and the weaknesses of none. It takes two minutes to build. 250-250 damage. |n|n|cffffcc00Attacks land and air units.|r

First, the most noticable difference in the Blast Furnace is the splash damage, it's nearly double the Meteor Watcher. An excellent addition to any defense. 225-250 damage. |n|n|cffffcc00Attacks land and air units.|r

Light technology tower. Has a long range and decent damage. 3-7 damage. |n|n|cffffcc00Attacks land and air units.|r

This Stone Tower is a welome addition to the stone line. This tower reduces the armor of the attacked unit by 5 and does formitable damage on it's own. 475-550 damage. |n|n|cffffcc00Attacks land and air units.|r

While it does nothing special, the Grave Marker is another staple addition to Poison. 270-340 damage. |n|n|cffffcc00Attacks land and air units.|r
